item.title: Birmingham 2026: European Athletics Championships day one – live
item.summary: Women’s 100m and men’s 5,000m top opening billing Britain ends 92-year wait | Mail Billy | Follow on TikTok The opening ceremony starts at a (for now) sparsely populated Alexander Stadium with everyone on their feet for God Save the King. This is, remarkably, the first time the European Championships have been held in Great Britain in their 92-year history. Here is Sean Ingle’s preview of the week ahead … Continue reading...
